v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Pacíficus * vocábitur, et thronus eius erit firmíssimus in perpétuum.
text.en: He shall be called * Peaceable, and his throne shall be most firm for ever.

text.la: Regnum eius * regnum sempitérnum est, et omnes reges sérvient ei et obédient.
text.en: His kingdom * is an everlasting kingdom, and all kings shall serve him, and shall obey him.

text.la: Ecce Vir Oriens * nomen eius: sedébit et dominábitur, et loquétur pacem géntibus.
text.en: Behold a man, the Orient * is his name: he shall sit and rule, and shall speak peace to the Gentiles.

text.la: Dóminus * iudex noster, Dóminus légifer noster: Dóminus Rex noster, ipse salvábit nos.
text.en: The Lord * is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver: the Lord is our king, he will save us.

text.la: Ecce dedi te * in lucem géntium, ut sis salus mea usque ad extrémum terræ.
text.en: Behold, I have given thee * to be the light of the Gentiles, that thou mayst be my salvation even to the farthest part of the earth.

text.la: Fratres: Grátias ágimus Deo Patri, qui dignos nos fecit in partem sortis sanctórum in lúmine, qui erípuit nos de potestáte tenebrárum, et tránstulit in regnum Fílii dilectiónis suæ.
text.en: Brethren: We give thanks to God the Father, who hath made us worthy to be partakers of the lot of the saints in light, who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of the Son of his love.

r.en: And there shall be no end of peace.

text.la: Habet in vestiménto * et in fémore suo scriptum: Rex regum, et Dóminus dominántium. Ipsi glória et impérium, in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: And he hath on his garment, * and on his thigh written: King of kings, and Lord of lords. To him be glory and empire for ever and ever.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in dilécto Fílio tuo, universórum Rege, ómnia instauráre voluísti: concéde propítius; ut cunctæ famíliæ géntium, peccáti vúlnere disgregátæ, eius suavíssimo subdántur império:
text.en: Almighty and everlasting God, who in thy beloved Son, the King of the whole world, hast willed to restore all things: mercifully grant that all the families of nations, now kept apart by the wound of sin, may be brought under the sweet yoke of his rule. Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

text.la: Ángeli, Archángeli, Throni et Dominatiónes, Principátus et Potestátes, Virtútes cælórum, Chérubim atque Séraphim, Patriárchæ et Prophétæ, sancti legis Doctóres, Apóstoli, omnes Christi Mártyres, sancti Confessóres, Vírgines Dómini, Anachorítæ, Sanctíque omnes, intercédite pro nobis.
text.en: O ye Angels, ye Archangels, ye Thrones and Dominions, ye Principalities and Powers, ye mighty ones of the heavens, ye Cherubim and Seraphim, O ye Patriarchs and Prophets, ye holy Teachers of the Law, O ye Apostles, O all ye Martyrs of Christ, ye holy Confessors, ye Virgins of the Lord, ye Hermits, O all ye holy children of God, make intercession for us.

v.la: Lætámini in Dómino, et exsultáte iusti.
v.en: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye just,

r.en: And glory, all ye right of heart.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui nos ómnium Sanctórum tuórum mérita sub una tribuísti celebritáte venerári: quǽsumus; ut desiderátam nobis tuæ propitiatiónis abundántiam, multiplicátis intercessóribus, largiáris.
text.en: Almighty, eternal God, Who granted us to honor the merits of all Thy Saints in a single solemn festival, bestow on us, we beseech Thee, through their manifold intercession, that abundance of Thy mercy for which we yearn.
